arXiv:2605.00733v1 [cs.NI] 2026 年 5 月 1 日arXiv:2605.00733v1 [cs.NI] 01 May 2026

轻松EASE：通过纠缠感知锚定闭合进行联合多模态学习: Federated Multimodal Unlearning via Entanglement-Aware Anchor Closure

Zihao Ding  Beining Wu  Jun Huang
Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
South Dakota State University
Brookings, SD 57007, USA
{Zihao.Ding, Wu.Beining}@jacks.sdstate.edu
Jun.Huang@sdstate.edu
摘要Abstract

联合多模态学习 (FML) 跨分散的客户端训练多模态模型，同时保持图像-文本对的私密性。然而，联合嵌入训练会在模式和客户端梯度子空间中纠缠被遗忘的知识，阻碍联合忘却。以前的联合忘却方法既没有切断由双线性耦合介导的跨模式重建通道，也没有将遗忘独占更新方向与保留客户端共享的更新方向分开。我们确定了联合多模态对比遗忘的锚定原则：通过双线性跨模态耦合、主角子空间纠缠和持续联合更新产生的三个残余锚点，遗忘的对齐持续存在。在模态层面，我们表明视觉和语言分支的双边位移关闭了跨模态重建通道。相应地，我们的方法通过客户端更新子空间的余弦-正弦分解来解决子空间纠缠，将遗忘独占方向与保留支持隔离开来。此外，我们提出了一种方向选择性忘记锁定来限制各轮的残余漂移。结合这些策略，我们提出Federated Multimodal Learning (FML) trains multimodal models across decentralized clients while keeping their image-text pairs private. However, joint embedding training entangles forgotten knowledge across both modalities and client gradient subspaces, hindering federated unlearning. Previous federated unlearning approaches neither sever the cross-modal reconstruction channel mediated by bilinear coupling nor separate forget-exclusive update directions from those shared with retained clients. We identify an Anchor Principle for federated multimodal contrastive unlearning: forgotten alignments persist through three residual anchors arising from bilinear cross-modal coupling, principal-angle subspace entanglement, and continued federated updates. At the modality level, we show that bilateral displacement of both visual and language branches closes the cross-modal reconstruction channel. Correspondingly, our method addresses subspace entanglement through Cosine–Sine decomposition of client-update subspaces, isolating forget-exclusive directions from retain support. Moreover, we propose a direction-selective Forget Lock that bounds residual drift across rounds. Combining these strategies, we present轻松EASE, 一个, anE纠缠-ntanglement-A器皿wareS子空间ubspaceExcision 框架，在统一设计下关闭所有三个锚通道。xcision framework that closes all three anchor channels under a unified design.轻松EASE在多个数据集和遗忘场景中表现出一致的优越性，例如，将重新训练参考与内部匹配demonstrates consistent superiority across multiple datasets and unlearning scenarios, for instance, matching the retrain reference to within0.20.2和and4.24.2R@1 点在使用 CLIP-B/32 的 Flickr30K 上的客户端遗忘下的遗忘和保留方面。R@1 points on the forget and retain sides under client unlearning on Flickr30K with CLIP-B/32.

1 简介Introduction

联邦学习（佛罗里达州）Federated Learning (FL)[29, 25, 51, 48, 9, 49, 34]允许多个客户端联合训练共享模型，同时保持原始数据的私密性，从而将其确立为分布式机器学习的关键范例allows multiple clients to jointly train a shared model while keeping their raw data private, establishing itself as a key paradigm in distributed machine learning[18, 55, 50]。最近的进展通过参数高效的低阶自适应 (LoRA) 将 FL 与多模态模型集成. Recent advances integrate FL with multimodal models through parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)[15]适配器，形成联合多模态学习（FML）adapters, forming Federated Multimodal Learning (FML)[6, 57, 46, 8]。服务器从不观察原始图像-文本对；它仅协调客户端更新，然后继续与其余客户端进行 FedAvg。当部署在受监管的领域时，FML 继承了被遗忘的权利. The server never observes raw image-text pairs; it only coordinates client updates and later continues FedAvg with the remaining clients. When deployed in regulated domains, FML inherits the right to be forgotten[40]：一旦客户端退出，目标概念变得过时，或者有害内容出现，系统必须近似仅保留再训练模型，而不集中已删除的对，这一任务称为“联合取消学习”: once a client withdraws, a target concept becomes obsolete, or harmful content surfaces, the system must approximate the retain-only retrain model without centralizing the removed pairs, a task referred to as Federated Unlearning[27, 14, 41, 10, 54, 47, 43]。我们在附录中回顾相关工作. We review related work in AppendixA.

如图所示As illustrated in Figure1，而联合遗忘引起了越来越多的兴趣, while federated unlearning has drawn growing interest[27, 44, 14, 53, 12, 52, 16, 30, 9, 45]，将其扩展到多模态模型仍然是开放的：仅客户端更新访问、对齐损失的双线性耦合以及持续的 FedAvg 共同创建单模态遗忘所缺少的故障模式。我们使用锚来表示一种残差机制，该机制在取消学习请求后保持被遗忘的图像文本对齐可重建，并在该机制中识别出三种这样的机制，我们将这种失败模式称为联合多模态对比取消学习的锚定原理。第一个问题的出现是因为联合嵌入训练通过双线性相似性将两种模态的遗忘知识纠缠在一起，因此一种模态的梯度取决于另一种模态产生的嵌入。单独从一个分支中删除参数，使另一个分支作为跨模式锚点，驱动对齐梯度回到原始配对，从而提出第一个问题：, extending it to multimodal models remains open: client-update-only access, the bilinear coupling of the alignment loss, and continued FedAvg jointly create failure modes absent from single-modality unlearning. We use anchor to denote a residual mechanism that keeps a forgotten image-text alignment reconstructible after an unlearning request, and identify three such mechanisms in this regime, a failure pattern we call an Anchor Principle for federated multimodal contrastive unlearning. The first arises because joint embedding training entangles forgotten knowledge across both modalities through the bilinear similarity, so the gradient with respect to one modality depends on the embeddings produced by the other. Excising parameters from one branch alone leaves the other as a cross-modal anchor that drives the alignment gradient back toward the original pairing, raising a first question:I）我们如何关闭这个模态锚点，同时保持每个分支的表示足够忠实以支持对保留的图像文本对的检索？I) How can we close this Modality Anchor while keeping each branch’s representation faithful enough to support retrieval over the retained image-text pairs?更重要的是，联合训练沿着连续频谱纠缠客户端梯度子空间，将遗忘集专有的方向与保留客户端共享的方向混合在一起。现有方法将忘记集的贡献视为不可分割的块，将可移动锚点与保留支撑混为一谈，正如我们在第 5 节中所确认的那样Compounding this, federated training entangles client gradient subspaces along a continuous spectrum, mixing directions exclusive to the forget set with directions shared with retained clients. Existing methods treat the forget set’s contribution as an indivisible block, conflating removable anchors with retain support, and as we confirm in Section2他们始终面临忘记与保留的权衡，引发了第二个问题：they consistently suffer a forget–retain trade-off, motivating a second question:II）我们如何识别和切除可移动的唯一子空间锚点，同时保留保留支持方向，删除这些方向会降低客户之间保留的知识？II) How can we identify and excise only the removable Unique-Subspace Anchors while sparing the retain-support directions whose deletion would degrade retained knowledge across clients?

即使前两个锚点在取消学习时关闭，每个客户端的本地 SGD 也会遵循沿移除方向具有非零分量的对齐梯度。如果没有持久的保护措施，后续的每一轮联合训练都会重写一部分被剪切的锚点，并逐渐消除遗忘的内容，从而提出了第三个问题：Even after the first two anchors are closed at the moment of unlearning, each client’s local SGD follows an alignment gradient with non-zero components along the removed directions. Without a persistent safeguard, every subsequent round of federated training rewrites a fraction of the cut anchors back and gradually undoes the unlearning, raising a third question:III) 我们如何防止连续回合中的时间重新锚定，同时让遗忘通道之外的方向自由恢复保留的知识？III) How can we prevent Temporal Re-anchoring across continued rounds while leaving directions outside the forget channel free to recover retained knowledge?

我们通过以下方式解决所有三个挑战We address all three challenges with轻松EASE: 一个: anE纠缠-ntanglement-A器皿wareS子空间ubspaceE用于联合多模态取消学习的 xcision 框架，基于轻量级 LoRA 适配器和冻结多模态主干上的投影算子构建。 为了挑战xcision framework for federated multimodal unlearning, built on lightweight LoRA adapters and projection operators over a frozen multimodal backbone. For challengeI)，我们建立, we establish双边知识切除（BKE）Bilateral Knowledge Excision (BKE)通过同时移动图像和文本分支来关闭模态锚点，因此双线性相似度无法再通过未触及的模态重建已删除的配对。这种双边原则在单一模式的遗忘中没有对应的原则。 为了挑战to close the Modality Anchor by displacing the image and text branches simultaneously, so the bilinear similarity can no longer reconstruct the removed pairing through the untouched modality. This bilateral principle has no counterpart in single-modality unlearning. For challenge二）II)，我们开发, we develop梯度子空间分解（GSD）Gradient Subspace Decomposition (GSD)。重用 FedAvg 期间已传输的客户端更新，服务器通过 SVD 提取每个客户端的子空间基并测量它们的成对主轴角；与保留子空间几乎正交的方向被视为遗忘排他性锚点，而与保留客户端共享的方向则被保留为保留支持。这用适应实际客户端子空间纠缠的单方向操作取代了二进制擦除或保留决策。 为了挑战. Reusing client updates already transmitted during FedAvg, the server extracts per-client subspace bases via SVD and measures their pairwise principal angles; directions nearly orthogonal to the retain subspace are treated as forget-exclusive anchors, while directions shared with retained clients are preserved as retain support. This replaces the binary erase-or-preserve decision with a per-direction operation adapted to the actual client-subspace entanglement. For challenge三）III)，我们设计, we devise忘记锁定投影 (PFL)Projection with Forget Lock (PFL)。在每一轮取消学习中，服务器将参数位移投影到唯一子空间的补集上，而客户端忘记锁会在本地 SGD 期间惩罚沿识别的唯一方向的漂移，从而使正交补集不受保留知识恢复的约束。投影在未学习的回合中关闭锚点，并且锁在持续训练中保持锚点关闭，漂移与正则化强度成反比。我们的主要贡献是：. At each unlearning round the server projects the parameter displacement onto the complement of the unique subspace, while a client-side Forget Lock penalizes drift back along the identified unique directions during local SGD, leaving the orthogonal complement unconstrained for retained knowledge recovery. The projection closes the anchor at the unlearning round, and the lock keeps it closed across continued training, with drift bounded inversely by the regularization strength. Our main contributions are:

  • ❶

    锚定原则。Anchor Principle.我们确定并形式化了联合多模态对比遗忘的锚定原则：遗忘的知识通过该机制中的三个主要锚定位置持续存在：模态锚定（双线性跨模态耦合）、唯一子空间锚定（主角度子空间纠缠）和时间重新锚定（残余对齐梯度场）；根据经验，关闭三者中的任何严格子集都会留下可测量的重建路径。该原理在三个实际场景中得到验证：客户端、类和样本遗忘。We identify and formalize an Anchor Principle for federated multimodal contrastive unlearning: forgotten knowledge persists through three principal anchor locations in this regime, the Modality Anchor (bilinear cross-modal coupling), the Unique-Subspace Anchor (principal-angle subspace entanglement), and Temporal Re-anchoring (residual alignment gradient field); empirically, closing any strict subset of the three leaves a measurable reconstruction path. The principle is verified across three practical scenarios: client, class, and sample unlearning.

  • ❷

    锚固闭合框架。Anchor Closure Framework.我们介绍We introduce轻松EASE，通过三个协调机制实现锚定原则：BKE 通过同时位移两个分支来关闭模态锚定，GSD 通过遗忘-保留子空间对的余弦-正弦分解将可移动锚定与保留支撑分开，PFL 通过服务器端投影和方向选择性客户端惩罚来防止时间重新锚定。我们通过独特子空间切除和保留方向保存的条件几何保证来支持该框架。, realizing the Anchor Principle through three coordinated mechanisms: BKE shuts the Modality Anchor by displacing both branches simultaneously, GSD separates removable anchors from retain support via the Cosine–Sine decomposition of the forget–retain subspace pair, and PFL prevents Temporal Re-anchoring through a server-side projection and a direction-selective client-side penalty. We back the framework with conditional geometric guarantees on unique-subspace excision and retain-direction preservation.

  • ❸

    实证验证。Empirical Verification.在 Flickr30K、COCO 和 TextCaps 上进行的实验表明，具有三个多模态骨干网，跨越三个不学习场景Experiments on Flickr30K, COCO, and TextCaps with three multimodal backbones across three unlearning scenarios show that轻松EASE最一致地缩小了九个联合和集中基线中遗忘和保留方面与再训练参考的差距，检索、对齐残差和影子/LiRA 成员推理指标确认了嵌入和推理级别的闭合。逐个锚点的消融证实，禁用任何单个闭合会重新打开该原理预测的独特故障模式。most consistently narrows the gap to the retrain reference on both forget and retain sides among nine federated and centralized baselines, with retrieval, alignment-residual, and shadow/LiRA membership-inference metrics confirming closure at the embedding and inference levels. An anchor-by-anchor ablation confirms that disabling any single closure reopens a distinct failure mode predicted by the principle.

所需要的。Desiderata.

目标是产生一个未经学习的模型The goal is to produce an unlearned modelw∗w^{*}满足三个标准：（i）忘记学习的完整性，检索行为satisfying three criteria: (i) unlearning completeness, the retrieval behavior ofw∗w^{*} on 𝒟f\mathcal{D}_{f}匹配的是matches that ofw~\tilde{w}; (ii) 保留完整性、性能; (ii) retention integrity, the performance ofw∗w^{*} on 𝒟r\mathcal{D}_{r}匹配的是matches that ofw~\tilde{w}; (iii)效率，成本远低于全面再培训。现有的方法试图通过消除遗忘数据的影响来满足这些标准; and (iii) efficiency, the cost is substantially lower than full retraining. Existing methods attempt to satisfy these criteria by erasing the forget data’s influence fromww作为一个整体，将忘记梯度子空间视为一个不可分割的块。这种盲目擦除无法区分遗忘专用方向（可移动锚点）和与保留共享的方向（保留支撑）；它也没有解决双线性跨模态耦合，使未触及的模态充当模态锚，正如我们在第 5 节中分析的那样as a whole, treating the forget gradient subspace as an indivisible block. This blind erasure cannot distinguish forget-exclusive directions, the removable anchors, from directions shared with retain, the retain support; nor does it address the bilinear cross-modal coupling that makes the untouched modality act as a Modality Anchor, as we analyze in Section3.2。这些挑战激发了第 1 节中的纠缠感知切除框架. These challenges motivate the entanglement-aware excision framework in Section3.

观察 1：现有的联合遗忘方法表现出一种忘记-保留的权衡，表明每个基线中至少有一个锚通道保持开放。Observation 1: Existing federated unlearning methods exhibit a forget–retain trade-off, indicating that at least one anchor channel remains open in every baseline.

我们评估四个联合的不学习基线，法拉利We evaluate four federated unlearning baselines, Ferrari[28], 联邦OSD, FedOSD[31], 不, NoT[20]，和灵魂, and SoUL[17]，在 CLIP-B32 上在 Flickr30K 上在三种遗忘场景下进行微调。我们报告了 Forget R@1，其中较低表示对遗忘集的更彻底擦除，以及 Retain R@1，其中较高表示保留知识的更好保存。图, on CLIP-B32 fine-tuned on Flickr30K under three unlearning scenarios. We report Forget R@1, where lower indicates more thorough erasure on the forget set, and Retain R@1, where higher indicates better preservation of retained knowledge. Figure2b显示大多数基线保持 Retain R@1 接近重新训练参考，这表明保留的知识在取消学习过程中仍然存在。图shows that most baselines preserve Retain R@1 close to the Retrain reference, suggesting retained knowledge survives the unlearning procedure. Figure2a然而，揭示了一种尖锐的失败模式：只有样本遗忘是有效的，而客户和班级请求则使遗忘集基本完好无损。 NoT 是一种例外，它会更积极地擦除，但代价是保留较低，而其余基线擦除不足。这些观察结果揭示了当前联合多模态遗忘中的紧张局势，促使人们更好地处理遗忘侧锚点和保留支持如何在客户端梯度更新中共存。, however, reveals a sharp failure mode: only sample unlearning is effective, while client and class requests leave the forget set largely intact. NoT is the exception that erases more aggressively, but at the cost of a lower Retain, while the remaining baselines under-erase. These observations expose a tension in current federated multimodal unlearning, motivating a finer treatment of how forget-side anchors and retain support coexist within client gradient updates.

观察 2：联合多模式训练中的客户端梯度子空间是部分纠缠的，并且它们的重叠允许从保留对齐支持到忘记独占锚点的连续主角谱。Observation 2: Client gradient subspaces in federated multimodal training are partially entangled, and their overlap admits a continuous principal-angle spectrum from retain-aligned support to forget-exclusive anchors.

观察 1 中的权衡源于客户端梯度更新的纠缠结构：忘记梯度子空间将可移动锚点（忘记独占方向）与保留支持（与保留客户端共享的方向）混合在一起，而盲目擦除将两者混为一谈。为了验证这一点，我们通过 FedAvg 在分布在 10 个客户端的 Flickr30K 上训练 CLIP-B/32 投影仪 30 轮，收集每轮参数更新，并通过 SVD 提取每个客户端的前 10 个更新方向。如图The trade-off in Observation 1 stems from the entangled structure of client gradient updates: the forget gradient subspace mixes removable anchors (forget-exclusive directions) with retain support (directions shared with retained clients), and blind erasure conflates the two. To validate this, we train a CLIP-B/32 projector on Flickr30K distributed across 10 clients via FedAvg for 30 rounds, collect per-round parameter updates, and extract each client’s top-10 update directions via SVD. As shown in Figure3a，成对子空间相似度变化很大，非对角线平均值为 0.49，证实客户端梯度子空间既不是完全共享也不是完全正交。图, pairwise subspace similarity varies widely with an off-diagonal mean of 0.49, confirming that client gradient subspaces are neither fully shared nor fully orthogonal. Figure3b按主角分解五个代表性对：在所有情况下，角度从共享方向的小值单调增加到唯一方向的大值。这些发现激发了一种纠缠感知分解，仅擦除忘记排他的唯一子空间锚点，同时保持保留支撑完好无损。decomposes five representative pairs by their principal angles: in all cases, the angles increase monotonically from small values for shared directions to large values for unique directions. These findings motivate an entanglement-aware decomposition that erases only the forget-exclusive Unique-Subspace Anchors while leaving the retain support intact.

3 方法论Methodology

3.1 框架概述Framework Overview

受观察 1-2 的启发，我们的框架依次关闭了三个锚通道（图Motivated by Observations 1–2, our framework closes the three anchor channels in turn (Figure4): I)双边知识切除（BKE，部分Bilateral Knowledge Excision (BKE, Section3.2）通过同时移动视觉和语言分支来关闭模态锚点；) shuts the Modality Anchor by displacing both visual and language branches simultaneously;二）II)梯度子空间分解（GSD，SectionGradient Subspace Decomposition (GSD, Section3.3) 通过忘记-保留子空间对的余弦-正弦分解，将可移除的唯一子空间锚点与保留支持分开；) separates removable Unique-Subspace Anchors from retain support via Cosine–Sine decomposition of the forget–retain subspace pair;三）III)带忘记锁定的投影（PFL，部分Projection with Forget Lock (PFL, Section3.4）通过服务器端投影和方向选择性客户端惩罚来防止时间重新锚定。禁用任何单个组件会重新打开不同的故障模式（表) prevents Temporal Re-anchoring through a server-side projection and a direction-selective client-side penalty. Disabling any single component reopens a distinct failure mode (Table2).

3.2 关闭模态锚点 (BKE)Closing the Modality Anchor (BKE)

模态锚。The Modality Anchor.

在具有双线性相似性的多模态模型（例如 InfoNCE）中，每种模态的梯度取决于其他模态的嵌入。单独删除一个分支上的参数方向会留下未修改的分支作为原始对齐的记忆，并且对齐梯度利用该记忆作为重建擦除配对的锚点。我们将这种残差编码称为遗忘集的模态锚点。 BKE 通过同时移动两个分支来关闭它。In multimodal models with a bilinear similarity (e.g., InfoNCE), each modality’s gradient depends on the other modality’s embedding. Excising parameter directions on one branch alone leaves the unmodified branch as a memory of the original alignment, and the alignment gradient exploits this memory as an anchor that reconstructs the erased pairing. We term this residual encoding the Modality Anchor of the forget set. BKE closes it by displacing both branches simultaneously.

锚定机构。Anchor mechanism.

跨模态对齐通过等式中的双线性相似性取决于视觉和语言参数。 （The cross-modal alignment depends on both the visual and language parameters through the bilinear similarity in Eq. (1）。要了解单侧切除失败的原因，请考虑忘记设置对). 3.3 闭合唯一子空间锚点 (GSD)Closing the Unique-Subspace Anchor (GSD)

可拆卸锚固件与保留支撑。Removable anchors versus retain support.

BKE 告诉我们对两种模式进行操作，但我们应该从每种模式中删除多少内容？在联合非独立同分布训练中，遗忘客户端的参数更新与保留客户端沿着连续的主角谱共享方向。我们需要将遗忘子空间分解为可移动的唯一子空间锚点（遗忘独占方向，可以安全擦除）并保留支持（与保留共享的方向，必须保留）。BKE tells us to operate on both modalities, but how much should we erase from each? In federated non-IID training, the forget client’s parameter updates share directions with retained clients along a continuous principal-angle spectrum. We need to decompose the forget subspace into removable Unique-Subspace Anchors (forget-exclusive directions, safe to erase) and retain support (directions shared with retain, must preserve).

5 结论Conclusion

我们研究了联合多模态遗忘，识别了三个重建锚点（跨模态耦合、忘记排他方向、遗忘后 FedAvg 漂移）并通过关闭它们We studied federated multimodal unlearning, identifying three reconstruction anchors (cross-modal coupling, forget-exclusive directions, post-unlearning FedAvg drift) and closing them through轻松EASE的双边切除、子空间分解和方向选择性忘记锁定； EASE 使遗忘/保留比评估的基线更接近重新训练。锚定原理适用于图像-文本双编码器检索（CLIP/SigLIP 风格）；后期融合、生成和多模式法学硕士扩展仍然是未来的工作。’s bilateral excision, subspace decomposition, and direction-selective Forget Lock; EASE moves forget/retain closer to retrain than evaluated baselines. The Anchor Principle is articulated for image-text dual-encoder retrieval (CLIP/SigLIP-style); late-fusion, generative, and multimodal-LLM extensions remain future work.

联合遗忘。Federated Unlearning.

联合遗忘可以重建退缩客户的影响力，而无需重新培训。历史重建校准剩余客户端的更新Federated unlearning reconstructs the influence of a withdrawn client without retraining. Historical reconstruction calibrates remaining clients’ updates[27, 3, 28];基于曲率和方向的方法通过二阶信号（SoUL; curvature- and direction-based approaches localize the forget contribution via second-order signals (SoUL[17]）或正交子空间投影（FedOSD) or orthogonal subspace projection (FedOSD[31]）；任务向量方法（NoT); task-vector methods (NoT[20]）减去忘记客户端累积更新的方向向量；最近的扩展通过非线性功能细化（FFMU) subtract a directional vector of the forget client’s accumulated update; recent extensions reduce cost through nonlinear functional refinement (FFMU[5]）或稀疏适配器覆盖（FUSED) or sparse-adapter overwriting (FUSED[60]）；和验证导向的研究); and verification-oriented studies[12, 14, 41, 53]提供补充审计工具。然而，这些方法假设单模态损失和一次性学习视图，因此不能解决联合多模态设置中的跨模态重建通道或持续训练漂移。provide complementary auditing tools. However, these methods assume a single-modality loss and a one-shot view of unlearning, and thus do not address the cross-modal reconstruction channel or continued-training drift in federated multimodal settings.

集中式机器遗忘。Centralized Machine Unlearning.

集中式方法假设有一个具有完全数据访问权限的可信管理者。精确的方法重新训练受影响的数据碎片Centralized methods assume a trusted curator with full data access. Exact approaches retrain affected data shards[2];近似方法通过遗忘损失的梯度上升来编辑训练模型; approximate approaches edit a trained model via gradient ascent on the forget loss[39, 13], 影响函数减法, influence-function subtraction[22]，来自保留教师的蒸馏, distillation from a retain-only teacher[23]，或参数坐标的重要性加权正则化, or importance-weighted regularization on parameter coordinates[21, 58, 1]。然而，这些方法都不是为遗忘而设计的，在对异构客户端的持续培训下，遗忘必须保持有效。. However, none of these methods is designed for unlearning that must remain valid under continued training over heterogeneous clients.

多模式遗忘。Multimodal Unlearning.

一小部分但不断增长的工作旨在消除多模态对比模型中的学习。 CLIP 专用橡皮擦A small but growing body of work targets unlearning in multimodal contrastive models. CLIP-specific erasers[32, 33]通过对指定的遗忘集和最近的多模态遗忘器进行微调来删除不需要的图像文本关联remove undesired image-text associations via fine-tuning on a designated forget set, and recent multimodal unlearners[24]通过发布双分支更新来确认跨模式耦合。然而，所有这些工作都是集中的，并假设对原始对的访问不受限制，因此它们不会转移到服务器仅看到梯度摘要的联合机制。acknowledge cross-modal coupling by issuing dual-branch updates. However, all these efforts are centralized and assume unrestricted access to raw pairs, so they do not transfer to the federated regime where the server only sees gradient summaries.

梯度子空间和重要性加权正则化。Gradient Subspace and Importance-weighted Regularization.

持续学习中两个历史悠久的家族与我们的子空间和锁组件密切相关。梯度子空间方法（GPMTwo long-standing families in continual learning are closely related to our subspace and lock components. Gradient subspace methods (GPM[36], Adam-NSCL [42], OGD [11]）将新的更新限制在单个过去任务子空间的正交补集，而重要性加权正则化器（EWC) confine new updates to the orthogonal complement of a single past-task subspace, while importance-weighted regularizers (EWC[21],SI, SI[58]）通过每个参数重要性分数来加权二次漂移惩罚。然而，这两个系列都是为集中式持续学习而不是忘记学习而设计的，并且既没有将遗忘子空间内的遗忘专用方向与保留共享方向分开，也没有在持续联合训练下保持有效。) weight a quadratic drift penalty by per-parameter importance scores. However, both families were conceived for centralized continual learning rather than unlearning, and neither separates forget-exclusive directions from retain-shared directions inside a forget subspace nor remains valid under continued federated training.

B.3 基线描述Baseline Descriptions

本节全面概述了我们实验中使用的九个对应项。我们按方法类别对它们进行分组。This section provides a comprehensive overview of the nine counterparts employed in our experiments. We group them by methodological category.

联合遗忘方法。Federated unlearning methods.

  • •

    联邦橡皮擦FedEraser [IWQOS’21] [27]。 FedEraser 是最早的联合遗忘方法之一。它通过组合来自其余客户端的缓存历史参数更新来重建重新训练模型的近似值，并通过校准聚合过程重播它们。这避免了完全重新训练的成本，同时生成的模型的行为类似于从未接受过遗忘客户数据训练的模型。. FedEraser is one of the earliest federated unlearning methods. It reconstructs an approximation of the retrained model by combining cached historical parameter updates from the remaining clients, replaying them through a calibrated aggregation procedure. This avoids the cost of full retraining while producing a model that behaves similarly to one never trained on the forget client’s data.

  • •

    美联储复苏FedRecover [标准普尔’23][S&P’23] [3]。 FedRecover 最初的目标是从中毒攻击中恢复，但自然地适应于联邦遗忘。它存储每轮梯度和模型信息，然后使用此历史记录来估计如果忘记客户端不存在，全局模型会是什么样子，应用低成本校正而不是从头开始重新运行训练。. FedRecover originally targets recovery from poisoning attacks but is naturally adapted to federated unlearning. It stores per-round gradient and model information, then uses this history to estimate what the global model would have looked like if the forget client had been absent, applying a low-cost correction instead of rerunning training from scratch.

  • •

    法拉利Ferrari [ICML'24][ICML’24] [28]。 Ferrari 在缓存的客户端梯度的指导下执行快速近似再训练。服务器构建每个客户端贡献的紧凑表示，并有选择地逆转遗忘客户端的影响，实现比重新训练显着缩短的挂钟时间，同时保持保留集的检索准确性。. Ferrari performs rapid approximate retraining guided by cached client gradients. The server constructs a compact representation of each client’s contribution and selectively reverses the forget client’s influence, achieving significantly lower wall-clock time than retrain while preserving retrieval accuracy on the retain set.

  • •

    美联储OSDFedOSD [AAAI'25][AAAI’25] [31]。 FedOSD 将正交子空间分解应用于客户端更新方向。它识别遗忘客户端更新所跨越的子空间，并将全局模型投影到远离该子空间的位置，有选择地删除遗忘组件。该方法在精神上与我们的方法接近，但在单模态模型上运行，并且不会将可移动锚定方向与遗忘子空间内的保留支撑方向分开。. FedOSD applies orthogonal subspace decomposition to client update directions. It identifies the subspace spanned by the forget client’s updates and projects the global model away from that subspace, selectively removing the forget component. The method is close in spirit to ours, but operates on single-modality models and does not separate removable anchor directions from retain support directions inside the forget subspace.

  • •

    不NoT [CVPR'25][CVPR’25] [20]。 NoT 将每个客户端的历史贡献视为一个任务向量，并通过从全局模型中减去忘记客户端的任务向量来执行遗忘。这会产生对遗忘集的积极擦除，但经常会损坏保留的知识，因为任务向量减法是统一应用的，没有分离共享和独特的组件。. NoT treats each client’s historical contribution as a task vector and performs unlearning by subtracting the forget client’s task vector from the global model. This yields aggressive erasure on the forget set but frequently damages retained knowledge, since the task vector subtraction is applied uniformly without separating shared and unique components.

  • •

    灵魂SoUL [EMNLP’24] [17]。 SoUL 使用二阶曲率信息来定位遗忘贡献。使用近似的 Hessian 或基于 Fisher 信息的信号，它估计哪些参数与遗忘数据最相关，并仅扰乱那些参数。虽然比基于梯度的基线更有针对性，但由于二阶估计，它会产生不小的计算成本。. SoUL employs second-order curvature information to localize the forget contribution. Using approximate Hessian or Fisher-information-based signals, it estimates which parameters are most relevant to the forget data and perturbs only those. While more targeted than gradient-based baselines, it incurs nontrivial computational cost due to second-order estimation.

  • •

    FFMU [ICML'23][ICML’23] [5]。 FFMU 通过将局部遗忘模型建模为 Nemytskii 算子的输出函数，并利用非线性函数分析来改进它们，从而加速联合遗忘。它通过减少计算量实现了有竞争力的遗忘质量，但在单模态模型上运行，并且没有解决多模态架构中存在的模态锚点。. FFMU accelerates federated unlearning by modeling local unlearning models as output functions of a Nemytskii operator and leveraging nonlinear functional analysis to refine them. It achieves competitive unlearning quality with reduced computation, but operates on single-modality models and does not address the Modality Anchor present in multimodal architectures.

  • •

    熔丝FUSED [CVPR'25][CVPR’25] [60]。 FUSED 通过训练覆盖特定遗忘知识的独立稀疏适配器来执行可逆联合遗忘。它通过敏感性分析来识别受影响最大的层，并仅重新训练这些层上的稀疏适配器，从而减少遗忘成本，同时保持过程可逆。与其他联合遗忘方法一样，它在单模态模型上运行。. FUSED performs reversible federated unlearning by training independent sparse adapters that overwrite forget-specific knowledge. It identifies the most affected layers through sensitivity analysis and retrains only sparse adapters on those layers, reducing unlearning cost while keeping the process reversible. Like other federated unlearning methods, it operates on single-modality models.

适应联邦环境的集中式遗忘方法。Centralized unlearning methods adapted to the federated setting.

  • •

    研究生上升GradAscent [USENIX 安全’22][USENIX Security’22] [39]。梯度上升是一种简单且广泛使用的去学习基线，它使用原始训练损失的负值对遗忘集执行梯度更新。我们通过在忘记客户端上运行局部梯度上升，然后在其余客户端上运行标准联合聚合来使其适应联合设置。尽管实现起来很简单，但它经常会出现超调并降低保留集性能。. Gradient ascent is a simple and widely used unlearning baseline that performs gradient updates on the forget set using the negative of the original training loss. We adapt it to the federated setting by running localized gradient ascent on the forget client followed by standard federated aggregation on the remaining clients. Although straightforward to implement, it often overshoots and degrades retain-set performance.

B.4 评估指标Evaluation Metrics

我们报告了四组指标来捕获遗忘完整性、保留完整性、隐私泄露和效率。We report four groups of metrics to capture unlearning completeness, retention integrity, privacy leakage, and efficiency.

检索准确率（Recall@Retrieval accuracy (Recall@kk) [CVPR'15][CVPR’15] [19].

回忆@Recall@kk是跨模式检索的标准度量。给定来自一种模态的查询，它测量另一种模态中的地面实况匹配是否排名靠前。is the standard metric for cross-modal retrieval. Given a query from one modality, it measures whether the ground-truth match in the other modality is ranked within the top-kk检索到的物品。我们报告召回@retrieved items. We report Recall@kk为了fork∈{1,5,10}k\in\{1,5,10\}，在图像到文本和文本到图像方向上取平均值。评估三个分割：(i) 遗忘集, averaged over both image-to-text and text-to-image directions. Three splits are evaluated: (i) the forget set𝒟¯f\bar{\mathcal{D}}_{f}对于遗忘完整性，较低的值表明模型已经忘记了目标对； (ii) 保留集for unlearning completeness, where lower values indicate that the model has forgotten the target pairs; (ii) the retain set𝒟¯r\bar{\mathcal{D}}_{r}对于保留完整性，较高的值表明保留的知识得到了保留； (iii) 用于泛化的保留测试集，其中较高的值表明遗忘不会损害样本外的表现。for retention integrity, where higher values indicate that retained knowledge is preserved; and (iii) the held-out test set for generalization, where higher values indicate that unlearning does not harm out-of-sample performance.

成员推理攻击（MIA）Membership inference attack (MIA)[标准普尔'17][S&P’17] [37].

我们采用 Shokri 等人的影子模型 MIA 协议：对于每个目标配置，我们独立训练具有相同架构、训练配方和数据分布作为目标的多个影子模型，在具有已知成员/非成员标签的不相交随机分割上。影子模型中的每样本损失和 logit 统计数据用于训练二元攻击分类器，然后将其应用于目标未学习模型以预测每个遗忘集样本是否是原始训练成员。报告的 MIA 分数是攻击在遗忘集上的真阳性率，即分类器标记为成员的遗忘样本的比例。一个未经充分学习的模型将遗忘样本映射到非成员的损失/逻辑状态中，因此其 MIA 分数向重新训练参考方向移动；较大的值表示攻击者可以利用残余记忆。因此，我们通过差距来衡量隐私泄露We adopt the shadow-model MIA protocol of Shokri et al.: for each target configuration, we independently train multiple shadow models with the same architecture, training recipe, and data distribution as the target, on disjoint random splits with known member/non-member labels. Per-sample loss and logit statistics from shadow models are used to train a binary attack classifier, which is then applied to the target unlearned model to predict whether each forget-set sample was an original training member. The reported MIA score is the attack’s true-positive rate on the forget set, i.e., the fraction of forget samples that the classifier labels as members. A well-unlearned model maps forget samples into the loss/logit regime of non-members, so its MIA score moves toward the retrain reference; larger values indicate residual memorization that an attacker can exploit. We therefore measure privacy leakage by the gap|MIAmethod−MIAretrain||\mathrm{MIA}_{\text{method}}-\mathrm{MIA}_{\text{retrain}}|，有一个小差距意味着未学习的模型接近于在这次攻击下从未见过遗忘数据的模型。绝对 MIA 值可能会低于, with a small gap meaning the unlearned model is close to a model that never saw the forget data under this attack. Absolute MIA values can fall below50%50\%因为影子模型分类器继承了训练池的类先验和损失分布偏斜；具有操作意义的量是与重新训练参考的差距，而不是与because the shadow-model classifier inherits the class prior and loss-distribution skew of the training pool; the operationally meaningful quantity is the gap to the retrain reference, not the distance to50%50\%.

LiRA 真阳性率LiRA true-positive rate at1%1\%假阳性率false-positive rate[标准普尔’22][S&P’22] [4].

总体 MIA 准确率可以隐藏最坏情况的泄漏，因为攻击者通常关心的是自信地识别一小部分训练成员，而不是平均表现良好。因此，我们还报告了 Carlini 等人的似然比攻击（LiRA）。在相同的影子模型池上进行评估。对于每个候选样本，LiRA 计算在影子模型 logits 上拟合的两个高斯分布之间的每个示例的似然比统计量（一个用于包含样本的模型，一个用于不包含样本的模型）；阈值经过校准，以便保留的非会员的误报率等于Aggregate MIA accuracy can hide worst-case leakage because an attacker usually cares about confidently identifying a small fraction of training members rather than performing well on average. We therefore also report the likelihood-ratio attack (LiRA) of Carlini et al. evaluated on the same shadow-model pool. For each candidate sample, LiRA computes a per-example likelihood-ratio statistic between two Gaussian distributions fitted over shadow-model logits (one for models that contain the sample, one for models that do not); the threshold is calibrated so that the false-positive rate on held-out non-members equals1%1\%，我们报告最终的真阳性率（, and we report the resulting true-positive rate (TPR​@​FPR=1%\mathrm{TPR}@\mathrm{FPR}{=}1\%）在忘记集上。值接近) on the forget set. Values near the1%1\%随机猜测线表明，在目标低 FPR 攻击者的攻击下，遗忘样本接近于非成员，而较大的值表明 MIA 总分可能会低估残余记忆。random-guess line indicate that forget samples are close to non-members under a targeted low-FPR attacker, while larger values indicate residual memorization that the aggregate MIA score can underestimate.

通讯费用Communication cost[18].

我们测量在取消学习过程中客户端和服务器之间传输的总有效负载（以兆字节为单位）。这包括模型广播、客户端更新和任何辅助张量，例如唯一子空间基We measure the total payload transmitted between clients and the server during the unlearning procedure, in megabytes. This includes model broadcasts, client updates, and any auxiliary tensors such as unique-subspace basesBu,vB_{u,v}和andBu,tB_{u,t}。较低的值表示部署的带宽开销较低。. Lower values indicate lower bandwidth overhead for deployment.

B.5 实施细节Implementation Details

模型架构。Model architecture.

我们使用 bf16 中的冻结预训练多模态编码器作为骨干。 fp32 中添加了两种类型的可训练模块：（1）插入到每个编码器的注意力层中的 LoRA 适配器，以及（2）将每个编码器的输出映射到共享 256 维嵌入空间的两层 MLP 投影仪（每个模态一个投影仪）。We use frozen pretrained multimodal encoders in bf16 as the backbone. Two types of trainable modules are added in fp32: (1) LoRA adapters inserted into the attention layers of each encoder, and (2) two-layer MLP projectors that map each encoder’s output to a shared 256-dimensional embedding space (one projector per modality).

梯度三角洲建设。Gradient delta construction.

每轮更新The per-round updateΔ​wk​[t]\Delta w_{k}[t]对于两种模块类型的计算方式不同。对于投影仪，我们直接计算局部状态和全局状态之间的参数差。对于 LoRA 层，每个适配器都贡献低阶修改is computed differently for the two module types. For the projectors, we directly compute the parameter difference between the local and global states. For LoRA layers, each adapter contributes a low-rank modificationB​ABA至冷冻重量；我们将有效权重增量计算为本地训练前后低秩乘积的差异，而不是差分to the frozen weight; we compute the effective weight delta as the difference in the low-rank product before and after local training, rather than differencingBB和andAA分开，因为只有产品在完整的参数空间中具有明确定义的解释。然后将这些增量进行列堆叠以形成梯度矩阵separately, since only the product has a well-defined interpretation in the full parameter space. These deltas are then column-stacked to form the gradient matricesGfG_{f}和andGrG_{r}（节(Section3.3).

取消学习场景设置。Unlearning scenario setup.

对于客户遗忘，指定客户For client unlearning, a designated clientk∗k^{*}退出联合会；其所有历史更新形式withdraws from the federation; all its historical updates formGfG_{f}, 和, andk∗k^{*}不参加后续轮次。对于样本遗忘，服务器指定一个全局遗忘集does not participate in subsequent rounds. For sample unlearning, the server specifies a global forget set𝒟f\mathcal{D}_{f}其样本通常跨越多个客户端（我们分区whose samples typically span multiple clients (we partition𝒟f\mathcal{D}_{f}在数据分割时跨客户端统一）；每个具有重叠样本的客户端对其本地忘记子集执行一轮训练，并上传生成的梯度，该梯度按列堆叠到uniformly across clients at data-splitting time); each client with overlapping samples performs one epoch of training on its local forget subset and uploads the resulting gradient, which is column-stacked intoGfG_{f}，每个客户随后继续培训, and every client subsequently continues training on𝒟k∖𝒟f\mathcal{D}_{k}\setminus\mathcal{D}_{f}。对于类遗忘，由于图像文本检索数据集（Flickr30K、COCO）缺乏分类标签，我们通过在预训练主干的串联视觉文本嵌入上运行 KMeans 来预先计算伪类分配，并将每个伪类均匀地分布在客户端之间；服务器通过与最近的集群质心匹配的文本描述符指定目标集群，在该集群中保存样本的每个客户端都会贡献每个客户端的梯度以形成. For class unlearning, since image-text retrieval datasets (Flickr30K, COCO) lack categorical labels, we pre-compute pseudo-class assignments by running KMeans on concatenated visual-textual embeddings of the pretrained backbone and distribute each pseudo-class uniformly across clients; the server specifies the target cluster via a textual descriptor matched to the nearest cluster centroid, every client that holds samples in that cluster contributes a per-client gradient to formGfG_{f}，并且所有客户端都从后续训练中排除目标簇样本。, and all clients exclude the target-cluster samples from subsequent training.
